authority: Owner GO — Bounded Maturity Approval and Integration Preparation

approvals.scope: Small-displacement linear statics; verified rigid-arm configurations; acyclic supported constraints; rotations and tie_rotations only when their mechanical meaning and DOF support are explicit.
Linear statics; six reference DOFs; translational independent-node DOFs; strictly positive weights; admissible full-rank geometry with sigma_min/sigma_max greater than 1e-12.
Verified affine, compatible, acyclic linear-static MPC systems. Cycles and incompatible constraints are refused.
Per-component weighted algebraic interpolation/extrapolation only; general spatial moment preservation is not guaranteed.
Dense reduced-system diagnostic for at most 180 active DOFs; conservative threshold, not a universal rank decision.

excluded_scopes: RBE3 weighted mode as a general spatial load distributor
MPC rank decision above 180 active DOFs
